[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/Mierkoles/CribbNotes/blob/main/mine_the_room_colab.ipynb)

*CPU-only, ~30 seconds to render. No GPU needed.*

Call out ten numbers and watch a model **search them for the pattern**, settling on
the two numbers that fit, sharpening as the data grows, then getting knocked off course
by a few bad points (with a robust alternative sitting right beside it). A few minutes
of pixels that make "training" feel mechanical instead of magical.

It's the simplest possible machine-learning model, and it's the foundation everything
else is built on. Start here.
